name: Skeletor Disturbing Facts

use: The top panel has Skeletor casually sharing a disturbing, depressing or unsettling fact, like a friendly end-of-episode lesson. The bottom shows him running off, usually with 'Until we meet again!', leaving you to sit with it.
slots: bottom panel: his exit line, usually 'Until we meet again!'
